verdict.rationale: The axis applies, and the only on-topic evidence is that an official GST Developer Portal exists at developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal with Register and Login pages. That points to some API program, but the pack shows no API reference, endpoints, auth flow or access terms. The rest of the pack covers manual portal workflows and an offline upload tool, not programmatic access. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints and reference docs, evidence the API is publicly accessible rather than gated, coverage of core actions (returns filing, payments, ITC) via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
